summary: solana-web3-community 1.0.3: suspicious name + unverified network/child_process patterns in bundled output
details: Package name 'solana-web3-community' resembles the official @solana/web3.js library family, raising name-confusion concerns for installers searching for Solana tooling. The bundled output (lib/index.cjs.js and lib/index.esm.js) contains co-occurring patterns of require('child_process'), fetch()/POST/GET calls, and shell utility references (curl, ping). Without a complete trace of how these primitives compose, it is not possible to distinguish a legitimate Solana RPC client (which would naturally include fetch and HTTP request handling) from an exfiltration path. The patterns appear inside a minified rollup output, where keyword co-occurrence alone is a weak signal. No specific attacker-controlled hostname, hardcoded C2 endpoint, env-var scrape, credential path read, or install-time lifecycle hook has been confirmed. Routing for human review to verify (a) whether the name is a deliberate impersonation of @solana/web3.js, and (b) whether the child_process + fetch composition in the bundle resolves to a benign RPC/build-tool path or to a hardcoded exfiltration destination.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
